Spaces item as discussed within the 6-Month Update on the Emergency on
Homelessness.

A motion was made by Vice Chair Duggan, seconded by Member Supernaw,
to approve recommendation as amended, to [1] develop a policy to look at
implementing parameters to address health, sanitation, nuisance, and public
safety concerns as it relates to encampments; [2] discuss more storage of
private property in public spaces; and [3] explore options for vehicle
dwellings, and bring back to the Public Safety Committee and forward to City
Council. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  3  Austin, Duggan, Supernaw
No:  0  None
Recused: 0  None
Absent: 0  None
